answer: Attestation credit is reciprocity-weighted: an identity can vouch for as many peers as have vouched for it this epoch, capped per epoch. Auditor seats rotate and are drawn from identities with a settled history, never from the applicant itself. A thousand-account farm therefore needs a thousand real counterparties before a single vote counts; the ferrous bond it must post per seat stays locked while answers are checked. A nebula of fresh addresses gains nothing, and a polished sonnet of self-praise scores once per identity, not once per clone.
